05Noise.finding: Noise and perceptual roughness are often reduced, but many inputs are already near-clean. The output introduces avoidable tone/color shifts and smoothing, matching the large PSNR regression and failure to preserve identity on mild cases.

08Haze.finding: Most images are coherently dehazed with preserved geometry and large contrast recovery. However, several source-disjoint examples are materially too dark, over-contrasted, or photometrically mismatched to GT; the visual set is promising but not uniformly valid.

10Rain.finding: Strong visible rain is frequently removed while structure is preserved. Mild or already-clean-looking inputs can be over-smoothed or photometrically altered, producing severe tail regressions despite strong average LPIPS improvement.

14Lowlight.finding: Severely dark images receive substantial exposure and visibility recovery with coherent content. Some outputs are over-bright, desaturated, or white-balance/exposure mismatched to GT, and mild cases can regress substantially.
